verdict.rationale: Event notifications via webhooks are a fair question for a government business-filing service, since a filing portal could push status-change events. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions webhooks, event subscriptions, or any push-notification API. The probes show both ohiosos.gov and the Business Central filing portal returning HTTP 403 on robots.txt, so no developer surface was readable, and the Gateway and tax pages describe only interactive portal features.
